description: INTERMEDIATE Fine-tuning - 500 steps/epoch (5x increase from v1). Balanced approach between subset (100 steps) and full dataset (1658 steps). Continues from v1 checkpoint. OBJECTIVE: Gradual data expansion to validate improvement before committing to full 55-hour training. Conservative strategy for cost optimization.

experiment_metadata.strategy: INTERMEDIATE - Gradual data expansion before full dataset

rationale.why_not_full_dataset_immediately: Full dataset = 1658 steps/epoch × 100 epochs = 55-83 hours training. Too expensive without validation. Intermediate approach (500 steps × 50 epochs = 8-12 hours) allows quick validation before committing to full training.

cost_optimization.compute_hours_saved: 43-71 hours if v1.5 shows no improvement
cost_optimization.validation_speed: Get results in 8-12 hours vs 3 days
cost_optimization.pivot_ability: Can stop early if diverges, minimal cost

expected_results.if_improvement: CER 15-20% → 12-15%, proceed to v2 full dataset
expected_results.if_no_improvement: CER stays ~15-20%, investigate why before v2
expected_results.if_degradation: CER > 20%, stop immediately, analyze root cause

after_v1.5.if_cer_improvement_5_percent: Proceed to v2 full dataset training
after_v1.5.if_cer_improvement_2_percent: Maybe proceed, but set realistic expectations
after_v1.5.if_cer_improvement_0_percent: STOP - Don't waste 55 hours on v2, pivot to ANRI fine-tuning instead
